payload.title: Multi-tenant active-tenant session switch
payload.description: Frick sessions are bound to a single tenant, so Zavro hand-rolls 'switch the caller's active tenant to another tenant they belong to' by minting a NEW session scoped to the target tenant while reusing the device/replica identity. Reference impl: handleTenantSwitch in ~/dev/aquariusyacht/apps/backend/src/runtime/routes.ts:232. The membership/authorization check is the app's; the session re-mint + tenant.ensure machinery is generic and belongs in the layer that already owns sessions, tenants, and partitioning. Provide a store.sessions API (or helper) for 'derive a sibling session in tenant X from this session'.
